newsitem.title: USA: Elderly woman is Fran's first victim.
newsitem.headline: Elderly woman is Fran's first victim.

text.p: An elderly motorist lost control of her car on a slippery road, becoming the first fatality blamed on Hurricane Fran, officials said on Thursday.

The woman, aged 66, was driving from the Myrtle Beach resort area to Sumter, South Caroline, on Thursday afternoon when she lost control of her car on a rain-slicked road and crashed into a tree, said South Carolina Highway Patrol Sergeant Mauro Andreucci.
The accident occurred on a two-lane highway about 4 p.m. EDT as Hurricane Fran's outer bands began to pound the coast with heavy rain and gusty winds.
"It's being treated as weather-related," Andreucci said.
The woman was not identified, pending notification of relatives, and she was described as the sole occupant of the car, police said.
The full force of Hurricane Fran and its 115 mph (185 kmh) winds was expected to push ashore between Myrtle Beach and Wilmington, North Carolina, sometime before midnight, forcasters said.
